title: Audit recipe selection and freshness without reading full transcripts
narrative: Quarterly audits need recipe selection, model/tool usage, latency/cost, freshness, policy decisions, retries, and failure classes without reading entire transcripts. Cost and decision telemetry already ship via `fangore_decision_plane_telemetry` and `nubble_insp_trace_envelope`. Tracks MH-PA-08[^insp-pa-08].
implementation: DecisionLog, TraceEnvelope, Cost events, bounded_retry recipe telemetry. Desired: recipe-selection and freshness as first-class audit dimensions end-to-end.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-PA-08, coverage partial, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
